title: Hurt and impact feel: fall/debuff hurt sounds and numbers, first-person hurt vignette, camera punch on bosses and heavy hits, Terraria knockback, real jump sound
player_outcome: Falling and burning hurt audibly and show numbers. In first person the screen flashes red at the edges when you are hit. The camera punches when a boss awakens, when it dies and on heavy hits and landings. Getting hit knocks you back properly, enemies hop back when struck, and the jump sound only plays when you actually jump.
design: Verified: FallDamaged (PlayerController.cs:46/269) has no subscriber. DoT uses Vitals.DamageDirect (GameWorld.cs:282) without reporting. The only CameraShake.Kick is explosions (CombatEffects.cs:35). The jump sound is inferred from v.Y > 3 (PlayerController.Sound.cs:29), so knockback plays it.

Core: GameWorld.HurtPlayerDirect(p, damage, DamageKind): DamageDirect + NpcSystem.ReportPlayerDamage(kind). Used by the DoT second-tick (Periodic) and exposed for fall damage (PlayerController.TrackFall calls it instead of the local-only FallDamaged).
SoundEvents: local PlayerHurt of any kind → 'player_hurt' (Periodic at −6 dB, max once per 0.8 s).

New game/UI/HurtOverlay.cs: a CanvasLayer ColorRect with new shaders/hurt_vignette.gdshader (radial red). On local hurt, alpha = 0.35 × clamp(4·dmg/MaxLife) in FP (0.15 in 3P), fading over 0.35 s. UserSettings.HurtFlash toggle (default on).

CameraShake.Punch(strength, seconds = 0.25, rollDeg = 1.5): a decaying impulse with roll. CameraRig applies roll to Camera.Rotation.Z. Calls: BossSpawned 0.45, BossDefeated 0.7, local hurt 0.1–0.35 by dmg/MaxLife, landing with airVelocityY < −14 m/s at 0.15.
Knockback toward Terraria: NpcSystem.ContactDamage knock = away·(4 + kb·0.6) + (0, 5.5, 0); ProjectileSystem.HurtPlayer similar.
NpcSystem.Knock: vertical = max(2.5, kb·1.1) for grounded non-bosses (a visible hop); crits ×1.4 knockback.
PlayerController: a new Jumped event raised where a ground/coyote jump starts; PlayerController.Sound plays 'jump' only on Jumped.
NpcRenderer: on HurtFlash rising, a 1.12 → 1.0 scale punch over 0.1 s; the tint lerps by HurtFlash/8 instead of on/off.
